details: Integrated dataset for the EcoTwin AI hackathon prototype.
All room, timetable, student, attendance, occupancy, equipment, tariff, distance and simulation records are SYNTHETIC; they are not verified DSATM records.
Use room_id as the shared key for timetable, equipment, energy, occupancy and session records.
480 rows: 8 semesters × A/B sections × 5 weekdays × 6 periods. Illustrative only; run conflict checks in your app.
160 fictional demo students; no real names or biometric images.
Synthetic attendance only; not official attendance and not generated by face recognition.
Counts are placeholders, not live webcam detections. Keep CV person counts separate from student attendance.
Wattage, daily hours and ₹8.50/kWh tariff are assumptions. Replace with measured data where available.
Schematic estimates for sample teaching rooms; not for navigation.
Example scenario figures are illustrative. The app should calculate results from current room/equipment inputs, not treat these sample outputs as authoritative.
Only enroll faces with informed consent; restrict access and provide a manual/non-biometric attendance fallback.

Import Rooms and Timetable; validate IDs/conflicts; build room availability API; compute energy from Equipment; add Occupancy Observations; implement simulation; use AI only to explain computed outputs.
